name: Steady
description: Steady brings complete context about what's going on at work into your Claude workflows. It continuously distills plans, progress, and activity across your tools and teams — so every conversation starts with the full story instead of a blank slate. Catch up on what you missed, ask questions about projects and goals, or post updates directly from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Steady to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Steady to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.steady.space/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Steady MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Steady lists 22 MCP tools, including create_activity, create_comment, get_absences, get_action_items, get_activities, get_check_in_form, get_check_ins, get_content_summary, get_digest, get_echo_answers, get_echo_questions, and get_goal_form.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Steady?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Steady in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Steady requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Steady is developed by Steady. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
